items.prompt: A single green apple with a small sticker on it sits in the middle of a bare wooden table in a dim room; two pairs of hands rest on the table on either side of it, one old and still, one younger and tense.

alt.ru: Одно зелёное яблоко с маленькой наклейкой посреди голого стола в полутёмной комнате, по сторонам две пары рук: старые и спокойные, молодые и напряжённые.
alt.en: A single green apple with a small sticker in the middle of a bare table in a dim room, a pair of hands on each side, one old and still, the other younger and tense.
alt.pt: Uma única maçã verde com um pequeno adesivo no meio de uma mesa nua, um par de mãos de cada lado: umas velhas e calmas, outras mais jovens e tensas.
alt.es: Una sola manzana verde con una pequeña pegatina en medio de una mesa desnuda, un par de manos a cada lado: unas viejas y quietas, otras más jóvenes y tensas.

items.prompt: A green apple in close-up on a table, and from it, as if seen in a vision, faint luminous lines spread outward and downward like roots and veins: through the table into soil, into a tree trunk, into rain clouds, the whole history of the apple drawn in light.

alt.ru: Зелёное яблоко крупным планом, от него расходятся светящиеся линии-корни: через стол в почву, в ствол дерева, в дождевые тучи.
alt.en: A green apple in close-up, luminous lines spreading from it like roots: through the table into soil, into a tree trunk, into rain clouds.
alt.pt: Uma maçã verde em close; dela saem linhas luminosas como raízes: pela mesa até o solo, o tronco e as nuvens de chuva.
alt.es: Una manzana verde en primer plano; de ella salen líneas luminosas como raíces: por la mesa hacia la tierra, el tronco, las nubes de lluvia.
